title: Awesome Jev research papers
scope: Curated direct preprints; findings remain author-reported. No experimental reproduction implied.

papers.title: Prism-1: Position- and Rival-Independent Scoring for System One Models
papers.en: An option-isolated readout targets order invariance and stable relative odds when candidates change; it requires fine-tuning, limits within-model comparison, and fits independently judged options better than menu-dependent fallback rules.
papers.zh: 通过隔离选项读出，使排列和候选变化时原有选项间的概率比保持稳定；需要微调并限制模型内选项比较，更适合可独立判断的选项，而非依赖整个候选集的兜底规则。

papers.title: Qwen-Audio-Jev: A Unified Interface for Audio Decisions
papers.en: An independent Jev-style decision head on Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR-Flash-Next gives Choice, Noul and Score readouts over audio, reporting 84.06% on MMSU, a 6.50% speaker-verification equal error rate and about 20× faster inference than its own base model.
papers.zh: 在 Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR-Flash-Next 上加入独立实现的 Jev 式决策头，对音频给出 Choice、Noul 与 Score 读出；报告 MMSU 准确率 84.06%、说话人验证等错误率 6.50%，推理速度约为其基础模型的 20 倍。

papers.title: JevAgentHarness: Benchmarking, Deploying and Training Decision Models That Share Control with LLMs
papers.en: Studies fitted confidence thresholds for sharing agent control with decision models.
papers.zh: 研究通过拟合置信度阈值，让决策模型参与 agent 控制。

papers.title: Jev-LiteMAS: Separating Decisions from Generation in Multi-Agent Workflows
papers.en: Routes expert handoffs and screens artifacts before generative re-review; lower generative-token use depends on the workload, with fixed expert pools and savings that shrink as more artifacts need repair.
papers.zh: 在生成式复审前进行专家交接路由和产物筛查；生成模型的 token 节省取决于任务，专家池固定，需要修复的产物越多，节省可能越少。

papers.title: System1-Arena: Which Decisions Can Be Left to System 1?
papers.en: A benchmark spanning matched requests and closed-loop tasks. Experiments have not been reproduced here.
papers.zh: 涵盖匹配请求与闭环任务的基准；本项目尚未复现其实验。

papers.title: Jev for Scientific Decisions: Evaluating Semantic Choices and Their Consequences
papers.en: In ten prepared scientific cases, the authors separate semantic selections, computed quantities and final labels; comparison-model errors can be hidden by unchanged final labels.
papers.zh: 作者在十个预设科学案例中分别评估语义选择、计算得到的数值与最终标签；对比模型的错误可能被不变的最终标签掩盖。

papers.title: Prune the Summary, Not the History: Source-Judged Compaction for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.en: Uses Jev to prune summary entries lacking source support; reported gains concern success in all three runs on two benchmarks, while useful constraints can be discarded and sourced errors retained.
papers.zh: 用 Jev 删除缺少来源支持的摘要条目；所报收益衡量两个基准上三次独立运行均成功的比例，但有用约束可能被删去，有来源的错误也可能保留。

artifact_note.en: Requires separate benchmark environments and model API access; not run here.
artifact_note.zh: 需另行配置基准环境和模型 API，本项目未运行。

papers.title: From Detection to Decision: Calibration and Deferral for Prompt-Injection Detection
papers.en: On 47,611 held-out prompt-injection examples, Jev ranks second in AUROC after an LLM judge, its native probabilities do not consistently beat post-hoc calibrated classifiers, and a 1% false-negative target forces over 91.8% escalation in every gate-reviewer system.
papers.zh: 在 47,611 条留出的提示注入样本上，Jev 的 AUROC 仅次于 LLM 评审，其原生概率并不总优于事后校准的分类器分数；若把漏报率目标定为 1%，所有门控—复核系统都需升级处理超过 91.8% 的输入。

papers.title: Verdict: Encode Once, Decide Many
papers.en: Encodes shared state once for multiple typed questions; invariance requires identical retained state tokens, while teacher-derived labels, adaptive testing and unstable BoolQ training constrain the reported gains.
papers.zh: 一次编码共享状态，回答多个类型化问题；不变性要求保留的状态 token 一致，教师模型标签、适应性测试过程及 BoolQ 训练不稳定限制了所报收益的解读。

artifact_note.en: Code and saved results; trained checkpoints are not included.
artifact_note.zh: 提供代码与已保存结果，未发布训练后的检查点。

papers.title: Lost in the Fallback: How Reliably Do Typed Decision Models Use Fallback Options?
papers.en: Paired tests on three text datasets separate category recognition from executing fallback rules; tested open models can disagree under equivalent definitions even when supplied the correct category, and the study diagnoses failures without establishing a fix.
papers.zh: 三个文本数据集的成对测试将类别识别与兜底规则执行分开；即使给出正确类别，所测开放模型在等价定义下仍可能产生分歧。研究诊断失效，未确立修复方法。

papers.title: Calibration and Risk-Budgeted Decisions with System One Models
papers.en: Jev and other System One models make binary allow/block or retain/discard decisions without human deferral; across six moderation, safety and reranking datasets, naive threshold selection exceeds the target risk in about half the settings, against 7.8% for Learn Then Test.
papers.zh: Jev 等 System One 模型在无法转交人工时做二元放行／拦截或保留／丢弃决策；在六个审核、安全与重排序数据集上，朴素阈值选择约在一半设置中超出目标风险，Learn Then Test 仅为 7.8%。

papers.title: Selective Reasoning for Typed Decision Models: When to Start, Read, and Stop

artifact_note.en: README inspected, not executed.
artifact_note.zh: 仅检查 README，未执行。

papers.en: Gates reasoning start, candidate-answer reading and generation stopping; evidence is limited to a frozen Qwen backbone and three task families.
papers.zh: 控制推理启动、候选答案读取与生成停止的时机；证据限于冻结的 Qwen 骨干及三类任务。

papers.title: Are AI Decision Models Biased? A Case Study of Jev
papers.en: In 41,500 responses Jev's selected answers look largely unbiased, but its judgments shift with irrelevant numbers and option order, and several bias manipulations move its probabilities even when the answer stays the same; on 30 adapted conjunction tasks it violates the conjunction rule in 54% of 15,000 responses.
papers.zh: 在 41,500 次回答中，Jev 选出的答案大体未显示偏差，但其判断会受无关数字和选项顺序影响，部分认知偏差操纵即使不改变所选答案也会明显改变返回的概率；在 30 个改编的合取任务上，15,000 次回答中有 54% 违反合取规则。

papers.title: Typed Decision Models on Tabular Data
papers.en: Tests classification and verification under content-preserving table rewrites across three task families; confidence can flag instability without proving correctness.
papers.zh: 在三类表格任务中检验保持内容不变的改写对分类与验证的影响；置信度可提示不稳定，但不证明正确性。

papers.title: SecJev: Bringing Security Expertise to System One Decision Models
papers.en: Adapts decision scorers to 14 security tasks; source-label prediction and displayed-policy execution are distinct targets, task difficulty is uneven, and benchmark accuracy does not establish end-to-end attack prevention.
papers.zh: 将决策评分器适配到14项安全任务；来源标签预测与显式策略执行是不同目标，任务难度不均，基准准确率不证明端到端攻击防护能力。

artifact_note.en: Release metadata checked; packages not loaded. Custom agreement and upstream terms apply.
artifact_note.zh: 已查发布元数据，未加载包；适用自定义协议及上游条款。

papers.title: More Choices, Fewer Decisions: Ordinal-Scale Bias in JEV-like Direct-Decision Models

artifact_note.en: anonymous mirror, expires 2027-04-10.

papers.en: Audits ordinal label underuse across selected decision models; finer scales increase compression, while accuracy, final-label utilization and averaged candidate probabilities remain distinct measures.
papers.zh: 审查所选决策模型对有序标签的使用不足；细化量表会加重压缩，准确率、最终标签利用率和平均候选概率仍是不同测量。

papers.title: DecisionRobust: Benchmarking Robustness for JEV Style Decision Models Across Text and Vision
papers.en: Text and vision attacks with label-validity checks and held-out evaluation models.
papers.zh: 结合标签有效性检查与留出评测模型，考察文本和视觉攻击。

papers.title: BLADE: Auditing Information Use for Failure Attribution in LLM Multi-Agent Systems
papers.en: Uses Jev to audit information use at agent handoffs and localize failures; comparisons share one decision model on five benchmark subsets, and attribution depends on the completeness of retained traces.
papers.zh: 用 Jev 审查 agent 交接时如何使用信息并定位失效；比较在五个基准子集上共用一个决策模型，归因质量受所保留轨迹证据完整性限制。

papers.title: Jeva: System One Models from First Principles
papers.en: A decision-model architecture exploring null handling, option permutations, scaling, and caching. Its design is Jeva’s, not Jev’s disclosed internals.
papers.zh: 探索空答案、选项排列、规模扩展与缓存的决策架构。这是 Jeva 的设计，并非 Jev 已披露的内部实现。

papers.title: VideoJev: System One Model for Video Understanding and Interaction
papers.en: Structured video decisions with temporal spans and candidate scores; cached and joint inference reuse visual computation.
papers.zh: 以时间区间和候选分数表达视频决策，通过缓存与联合推理复用视觉计算。

papers.title: Nudge the Judge: Uncovering Program Decision Hijacking in Real-World Jev Applications

artifact_note.en: README inspected, not executed.
artifact_note.zh: 仅检查 README，未执行。

papers.en: JevProbe traces attacker-controlled context into the decisions that 228 popular Jev applications act on; in 2,273 curated cases (at most ten per app, flips selected first, so not an unbiased sample) 81.5% flip, 98.6% of flips with potential downstream security impact, and existing defenses offer limited protection.
papers.zh: JevProbe 追踪攻击者可控的上下文如何影响 228 个热门 Jev 应用据以执行的决策；在 2,273 个精选用例中（每个应用至多十条、优先选取翻转案例，并非无偏样本），81.5% 出现决策翻转，其中 98.6% 可能造成下游安全影响，现有防御作用有限。

papers.title: Jev-ToM: Evaluating Theory of Mind in Typed Decision Models

artifact_note.en: source-benchmark terms apply.
artifact_note.zh: 各来源基准的使用条款仍然适用。

papers.en: On 11,117 English Theory of Mind questions from nine benchmarks, Jev reaches 73.2% source-balanced accuracy and ranks first or second in all six capability groups among twelve typed and generative models; confidence-based selection is benchmark-dependent, and supplied reasons repair or overturn answers depending on how they are attached.
papers.zh: 在来自九个基准的 11,117 道英文心智理论题上，Jev 的来源均衡准确率为 73.2%，在十二个类型化与生成式模型中六类能力均列前二；基于置信度的选择效果因基准而异，附加理由则视其附加方式，可能纠错，也可能推翻正确答案。

papers.title: Reading Right, Acting Wrong: Diagnosing Decision Failures of System One Models in Agent Loops
papers.en: Pairs factual probes with action choices to diagnose decision failures.
papers.zh: 将事实探针与行动选择配对，诊断决策失败。

papers.title: How Reliable Are System-One Decisions in Medicine? A Comparative Study of Jev, Jev-like Models, and LLMs
papers.en: Across 15 medical datasets (8,742 instances), Jev rivals leading models on text-driven tasks, is weaker on numerical ones and is the most stable under question-format changes; most models miss absent correct answers. A benchmark study, not clinical validation.
papers.zh: 在 15 个医学数据集（8,742 个实例）上，Jev 在文本主导任务上可比肩领先模型、数值任务较弱，题目格式变化下最稳定；多数模型难以识别正确答案缺失。这是基准研究，不是临床验证。

papers.title: Judges Follow the Reference: The Derivation Gap in Verifying Tool-Call Arguments

artifact_note.en: model outputs are not included.
artifact_note.zh: 不包含模型输出。

papers.en: Tool-argument judges including Jev reject some correct derived values without visible references; model-generated references are evaluated on three benchmarks.
papers.zh: 包括 Jev 在内的工具参数评判模型，在缺少可见参考时会拒绝部分正确推导值；模型生成的参考在三个基准上接受评测。

papers.title: Recalibrating Many Questions with Few Labels: Minimax Rates and Identification Limits
papers.en: Derives excess-Brier risk bounds for pooling recalibration across questions under shared-distribution and monotonicity assumptions; fixed-effects and empirical-Bayes results have different targets, and risk lower bounds do not directly become calibration-error lower bounds.
papers.zh: 在共享输出分布与单调性假设下，推导跨问题合并重校准的超额 Brier 风险界；固定效应与经验贝叶斯结果的目标不同，风险下界不能直接视为校准误差下界。

papers.title: PRISM: Calibrating Black-Box Judges with Counterfactual Probes
papers.en: Learns a score correction from counterfactual probes and human labels; improved ranking agreement on two text tasks is distinct from probability calibration, and probe cost and cross-task transfer remain relevant limits.
papers.zh: 利用反事实评分探针和人类标签学习校正；两个文本任务上的排序一致性提升不同于概率校准，额外探针成本与跨任务迁移仍是重要限制。

papers.title: Consider, Then Choose: Order-Invariant Decisions in System One Models
papers.en: Runoff scores options individually, then balances finalist positions; order invariance assumes deterministic responses and a unique ranking, and does not resolve option-name bias or guarantee more accurate decisions.
papers.zh: Runoff 先逐个评分选项，再平衡入围候选的位置；顺序不变性假设响应确定且排序唯一，不能解决选项名称偏置，也不保证决策更准确。

papers.title: Cheap, Consistent, Calibrated, but Biased? Typed Decision Models as Judges
papers.en: CALM pairwise challenges expose position and rewrite sensitivity despite consistency and calibration; inherited reference labels and rewrites that change more than tone limit causal interpretation and transfer to other judging tasks.
papers.zh: CALM 成对挑战显示，一致性和校准并不能消除位置与改写敏感性；沿用的参考标签，以及不只改变语气的改写，限制了因果解释和对其他评判任务的推广。

artifact_note.en: Declared MIT code; benchmark and results CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
artifact_note.zh: 声明代码为 MIT；基准与结果为 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0。

papers.title: Same Attack, Different Judge: A First Controlled Adversarial Comparison of Jev, LLM Judges, and Purpose-Built Safety Classifiers
papers.en: A controlled adversarial comparison of Jev, LLM judges, and purpose-built safety classifiers.
papers.zh: 对 Jev、LLM 评判模型与专用安全分类器进行受控对抗比较。

papers.title: LLM-as-Jev: LLMs Are Already Jev-Style Decision Models -- When and How to Fine-Tune Them
papers.en: Compares frozen Qwen decision readouts with optional KL-anchored fine-tuning and budgeted reasoning; reported gains depend on backbone size and routing workload, not disclosure of hosted Jev internals.
papers.zh: 比较冻结 Qwen 的决策读出、带 KL 锚定的可选微调与限预算推理；所报收益依赖骨干规模和路由任务，并不揭示托管 Jev 内部实现。

papers.title: Decision Models vs. LLMs as Rubric Judges: Cheaper, Faster, and Wrong in the Same Places
papers.en: Compares rubric judges and examines correlated errors that can limit cascade improvements.
papers.zh: 比较评分准则评判模型，考察相关错误如何限制级联系统的收益。

papers.title: Releasing the Inner Jev: A Simple Recipe for Open Decision Models
papers.en: Answer-letter readout and supervised LoRA baselines; evaluation includes model-generated labels.
papers.zh: 答案字母概率读出与监督式 LoRA 基线；评测包含模型生成的标签。

papers.title: FunDM: Cheap & Label-Free Decision Models from Frozen Language Models
papers.en: Distills teacher probabilities into small heads using fewer layers of a frozen Qwen3-8B; label-free means no correct-answer training labels, and efficiency measurements cover one GPU and engine workload rather than production serving.
papers.zh: 把教师概率蒸馏到较浅的冻结 Qwen3-8B 计算路径上的小型决策头；无标签指不使用正确答案训练标签，效率测量只覆盖一个 GPU 和引擎任务，而非生产服务。

papers.title: Does a Hosted Decision Model Respect Irrelevant Alternatives? A Pre-Registered Test of Option-Set Dependence in Jev
papers.en: Adding an irrelevant option shifts jev-1.13.0’s gold-versus-rival log-odds, more so as options grow, so its probabilities are relative to the option list; independent yes/no scoring removes this but is less accurate (pre-registered, 299,463 calls, three datasets).
papers.zh: 加入无关选项会改变 jev-1.13.0 对正确标签与最强错误标签的对数几率，选项越多偏移越大，因此其概率只相对于所给选项列表成立；逐项独立的是非评分可消除这种依赖，但准确率更低（预注册，299,463 次调用，三个数据集）。

papers.title: GraphDecisionBench: Benchmarking System One Models on Graph Tasks
papers.en: Compares graph decisions across fourteen model-interface configurations; local adjacency, graph-text evidence use and sequential solution quality are separate capabilities.
papers.zh: 比较十四种模型—接口配置的图决策；局部邻接识别、图文证据利用与序列构造解的质量是不同能力。

papers.title: General Decision Models: Benchmarking and Insights Beyond Jev
papers.en: Bilingual decision evaluation and reliability when local decisions compose into larger systems.
papers.zh: 双语决策评估，以及局部决策组合成更大系统时的可靠性。

papers.title: Suggested Is Not Superseded: A Pre-Registered Evaluation of a System-One Model as a Memory-Retirement Gate
papers.en: Jev memory-retirement evaluation separates confirmed updates from suggestions; mixed LLM/human labels, shared errors and selection on a small development set constrain cascade claims.
papers.zh: Jev 旧记忆停用评测区分已确认更新与变化暗示；LLM／人工混合标注、共享错误及小型开发集上的选择限制了级联收益主张。

papers.title: Poisoned into Action: Context Attacks on Typed Decision Workflows
papers.en: Traces context poisoning through retrieval, typed choices and persisted execution while measuring retained clean utility; two synthetic development workflows and nonsignificant prespecified contrasts make the findings exploratory.
papers.zh: 追踪上下文投毒经检索、类型化选择到持久化执行的路径，并衡量保留的正常任务效用；仅覆盖两个合成开发工作流，预设比较未达显著，结论仍属探索性。

artifact_note.en: Public subset; full call archives and private attestations are omitted.
artifact_note.zh: 公开子集；完整调用归档与私有证明材料未包含。

papers.title: SanSi: A Looped Typed Decision Model for System 1.5 Thinking

artifact_note.en: covering part of the paper's experiments.
artifact_note.zh: 覆盖论文的部分实验。

papers.en: Looped hidden-state computation for typed decisions; additional loops trade compute for accuracy.
papers.zh: 通过隐状态循环计算输出类型化决策；额外循环以计算成本换取准确率。

papers.title: JevCascade: Readout Stability and Inference-Time Compute Allocation for Prefill-Only Decision Models
papers.en: Candidate-menu interventions and confidence cascades; ranking stability does not establish probability calibration.
papers.zh: 研究候选集合干预与置信度级联；排序稳定性并不等同概率校准。

papers.title: Koa-decision: Fast and Consistent Structured Decision Making with Generative LLMs
papers.en: Uses atomic label tokens and supervised fine-tuning for single-step constrained decisions; latency follows a specified sequential serving protocol, adaptation differs across baselines, and the production intent data cannot be released.
papers.zh: 通过原子标签 token 和监督微调实现单步受约束决策；延迟采用指定的顺序服务测量协议，不同基线的适配程度不同，生产意图数据无法公开。

papers.title: Jev in Medicine: A Benchmark Evaluation
papers.en: Preliminary medical-benchmark evaluation of Jev 1.13 reports task-dependent accuracy, calibration and weak unanswerable-question detection; it does not establish clinical deployment validity.
papers.zh: Jev 1.13 的初步医学基准评测报告了随任务变化的准确率、校准表现及较弱的不可回答问题识别能力；这不能证明临床部署有效性。

papers.title: Same Scores, Different Decisions: Evaluating JEV and Language Models for Legal Document Understanding
papers.en: ContractNLI request variations can change which answers are wrong while aggregate accuracy stays unchanged; stable answers may preserve errors. This benchmark does not validate real legal deployment.
papers.zh: ContractNLI 请求变化可能改变具体错误答案，而总体准确率保持不变；稳定答案也可能保留错误。该基准不能验证真实法律场景的部署有效性。

papers.title: DICE: Tilting the Odds through Interface Attackson System One Model
papers.en: Tests bounded substitutions at state-extraction, question-generation and output-interpretation adapters while leaving authentic Jev responses intact; three synthetic pilots locate decision-integrity failures without estimating deployed attack prevalence.
papers.zh: 在状态抽取、问题生成和输出解释适配层测试有界替换，保持 Jev 原始响应不变；三个合成试验定位决策完整性失效，不估计实际部署中的攻击发生率。

papers.title: Does System One Transfer? Calibrated Typed-Decision Models, Label Budgets, and Translation for Indonesian Regional Languages
papers.en: Tests Jev and multilingual Laya on Indonesian regional-language tasks; stable expected calibration error can coexist with worse error ranking, while human translation, label budgets and cascade choices change comparisons.
papers.zh: 在印尼地方语言任务中测试 Jev 与多语言 Laya；预期校准误差稳定仍可伴随错误排序变差，人类翻译、标签预算与级联选择会改变比较条件。

papers.title: When Faster Decisions Do Not Make Better Agents: An Empirical Study of Jev in Agent Workflows
papers.en: Jev cut decision cost and latency for five agents in ALFWorld and AndroidWorld (4,500 runs), but two mobile agents lost more success, extra reasoning and interactions absorbed the savings, and cost per success rose for one agent.
papers.zh: Jev 让 ALFWorld 与 AndroidWorld 中五个 agent 的决策成本和时延下降（共 4,500 次运行），但两个移动端 agent 成功率降幅较大，辅助推理与额外交互抵消了节省，其中一个 agent 的单次成功成本反而上升。

papers.title: TypedBench: A Benchmark for Calibration, Framing Sensitivity, and Cost in System One Decision Models
papers.en: The hosted model is wording-sensitive and underconfident, and under asymmetric costs acting on its probabilities can cost more than taking its top answer; synthetic policy-labelled suites also report paraphrase ranges and calibration against a finite-sample noise floor.
papers.zh: 托管模型对措辞敏感且系统性信心不足，在非对称成本下按其概率行动的代价可能高于直接采用最高答案；基于带策略标签的合成测试集，还报告不同改写下的准确率范围及相对有限样本噪声下限的校准误差。

papers.title: JEV-as-a-Judge: Accept When Confident, Escalate When Unsure
papers.en: Studies confidence-based escalation from Jev to a reasoning judge, including limits under distribution shift.
papers.zh: 研究基于置信度从 Jev 升级到推理评判模型的方法，以及分布变化下的局限。

papers.title: One Word Opens the Gate: The Option-Channel Attack on Typed Decision Models as Agent Guardrails
papers.en: Tests option-channel attacks on seven open-weight models; reversed decisions can remain confident. The reported experiments do not test hosted Jev.
papers.zh: 测试七个开放权重模型的选项通道攻击；决策翻转后仍可能高置信。报告中的实验未测试托管 Jev。

papers.title: Specialized Decision Models vs. General-Purpose LLMs: Benchmarking Jev Across Knowledge, Reasoning, and Multilingual Tasks
papers.en: Knowledge, reasoning and multilingual multiple-choice evaluation of Jev; reported rankings and mathematical weaknesses apply to the selected models and benchmarks.
papers.zh: 在知识、推理和多语言选择题中评测 Jev；报告的排名及数学弱点仅适用于所选模型与基准。

papers.title: Can Decision Models Understand Stance? Evaluating Jev Against General-Purpose LLMs
papers.en: Compares Jev on English single-text stance and Chinese conversational stance. Support/opposition errors grow in the conversational task, but language, dataset and input structure change together; differing batching and prompt formats also limit a general language-capability ranking.
papers.zh: 比较 Jev 的英语单文本立场与中文对话立场识别；对话任务中支持／反对混淆更明显，但语言、数据集和输入结构同时变化，批处理及提示格式也不同，不能据此形成通用语言能力排名。

papers.title: MetaEncoder: Exploring the Limit of Bi-Encoders for Multimodal System One Decision Making with Natural Language Interface
papers.en: Bi-encoder approach to multimodal decisions and retrieval through natural-language interfaces.
papers.zh: 通过自然语言接口实现多模态决策与检索的双编码器方法。

papers.title: JevOut: Natural Context Can Flip Decision Models
papers.en: Optimizes context additions around unchanged questions and options in four decision systems; results concern initially correct decisions, and human validity checks cover a sampled subset of successful attacks.
papers.zh: 在四种决策系统中围绕不变的题目和选项优化上下文补充；结果针对原本答对的决策，人工有效性检查仅覆盖成功攻击的抽样子集。

papers.title: Type-Safe Is Not Error-Free: Typed Decision Models Follow the Option Name, Not the Definition Bound to It
papers.en: Tests conflicts between option names and definitions despite structurally valid outputs.
papers.zh: 检验输出结构合法时，选项名称与定义之间的冲突。

papers.title: Where Can a Decision Model Diagnose HVAC Faults? Reasoning Demand, Physical Representation, and Robustness Under Shift
papers.en: Tests fault diagnosis across equipment, representations and operating shifts. Physical features enable selected diagnoses, while context-dependent faults remain difficult; shared-day training conditions, small fault-day counts and dataset-specific option sets limit general claims of robustness.
papers.zh: 跨设备、表示和运行变化测试故障诊断。物理特征支持部分诊断，但依赖运行上下文的故障仍困难；共享日条件、少量故障日与各数据集不同的选项集，限制通用鲁棒性结论。

papers.title: From Probabilities to Decisions: Search and Multi-Teacher Distillation with Jev
papers.en: Distills Jev and LLM judgments into compact search evaluators and rerankers; matched-label-budget gains in chess do not generalize to every tested game. The deployed bot also uses Stockfish, opening books and tablebases, and API wall time differs from GPU labeling time.
papers.zh: 将 Jev 与语言模型判断蒸馏为紧凑搜索评估器和重排器；相同标签预算下的棋类收益并未推广到所有测试游戏。部署机器人还依赖 Stockfish、开局库与残局库，API 墙钟时间也不同于 GPU 标注耗时。

papers.title: Same-Number Citation Swaps: Stress-Testing Jev as a Financial Evidence Judge
papers.en: Same-number citation swaps probe financial-evidence verification; rejecting wrong roles trades off with accepting equivalent support in a constructed test.
papers.zh: 以同数值引用替换检验金融证据验证；在构造测试中，识别财务项目错配与接受等价证据之间存在权衡。

papers.title: Token-Efficient Multi-Agent Collaboration via System One-Guided Computational Division of Labor
papers.en: Separates bounded multi-agent coordination from LLM reasoning through a controller–reader loop; reported GPT-4o-token and end-to-end latency reductions concern complete framework comparisons on seven benchmarks.
papers.zh: 通过控制器—读取器循环分离多智能体的有界协调与 LLM 推理；报告的 GPT-4o token 用量和端到端时延下降来自七个基准上的完整框架比较。

papers.title: Benchmarking System One Models in Online Moderation
papers.en: Separates written rules, retrieved precedents and candidate restrictions across five moderation benchmarks. Retrieval can improve discrimination or merely change flagging rates; using labeled evaluation examples as precedents and representing media through generated captions limits deployment claims.
papers.zh: 在五个审核基准中区分书面规则、检索先例和候选限制。检索可改善区分能力，也可能只是改变被标记内容的比例；使用带标签评测样本作先例、用生成描述表示媒体，会限制部署结论。

papers.title: JEV versus LLMs: Accuracy, Cost and Calibration on Seven Political Science Replications
papers.en: Studies accuracy, cost, and calibration in seven political-science replication tasks.
papers.zh: 在七项政治学复现任务中考察准确率、成本与校准。

papers.title: Benchmarking candidate coverage and rejection policy transfer in typed decision models
papers.en: Separates artificial omissions, retrieval misses and out-of-scope queries under matched calibration budgets; a source-task threshold can reject covered target inputs or miss absent answers. Candidate membership, label ambiguity and small natural-miss samples limit transfer claims.
papers.zh: 在相同校准预算下区分人为移除、检索遗漏与范围外查询；源任务阈值可能误拒目标任务中已有答案的输入，或漏检缺失答案。候选成员、标签歧义及自然遗漏的小样本限制迁移结论。

artifact_note.en: Recorded-output scoring is separate from reconstructing source text and fresh inference.
artifact_note.zh: 已记录输出评分与源文本重建、重新推理分开。

papers.title: Benchmarking System One decision models against trained classifiers and language models for automated decision gates
papers.en: A common-request harness compares typed decision models, generative readouts and trained classifiers; accuracy, selective coverage and out-of-scope acceptance depend on label access and task.
papers.zh: 用共同请求框架比较类型化决策模型、生成模型读出与训练分类器；准确率、选择性覆盖率和域外接纳取决于是否有任务标签及具体任务。

papers.title: SharedKV-BT: Node-Local Typed Decisions for Behavior-Tree Agents
papers.en: Combines shared-prefix candidate scoring with behavior-tree node interfaces and external execution checks. The experiments separate scoring speed, stage restrictions and postcondition authority; predefined trees, simulated tasks and order-sensitive choices limit broader closed-loop reliability claims.
papers.zh: 把共享前缀候选评分、行为树节点接口与外部执行检查结合，区分评分速度、阶段限制和后置条件的权限。预定义树、仿真任务及对顺序敏感的选择，限制了更广泛的闭环可靠性结论。

papers.title: ufakzeka-karar: An Open Turkish Typed-Decision Model with Order-Invariant Option Scoring

artifact_note.en: Apache-2.0.
artifact_note.zh: Apache-2.0。

papers.en: An open 182M-parameter Turkish model scores each option blind to the others, so answers ignore option order, and adds a “not sure” signal; its 7th-of-16 HakemBench rank is not blind, since later runs trained after full-test results were read.
papers.zh: 开源的 1.82 亿参数土耳其语模型对每个选项独立评分，答案不受选项顺序影响，并提供“不确定”信号；其在 HakemBench 16 行中排第 7 的结果并非盲测，因为后续训练是在读过完整测试结果后进行的。

papers.title: SoK: Semantic Decision Engines in Network Control Loops
papers.en: Surveys semantic engines in network control loops; separates valid decisions, action feasibility, service checks and deadline attainment, with bounded event-model tests rather than production validation.
papers.zh: 综述网络控制环中的语义引擎，区分决策格式有效、动作可行、服务核查与期限达成；验证来自有界事件模型测试，而非生产部署。

papers.title: Probability Contracts: Accuracy, Coherence, and Decisions Across LLM Interfaces
papers.en: Known-posterior finite worlds separate probability accuracy, interface coherence and decision loss. Averaging can improve expected Brier score without improving a policy at every deferral cost; valid-report coverage and each comparison's reference policy remain essential.
papers.zh: 用已知后验的有限世界区分概率准确性、接口一致性和决策损失。取平均可改善期望 Brier 分数，却不保证每个转交成本下的策略更好；有效输出覆盖率与具体对照策略不可省略。

papers.title: Hidden Risks of Jev: An Empirical Study of Security, Privacy, and Dual Use

artifact_note.en: no license declared.
artifact_note.zh: 未声明许可。

papers.en: Tests the official Jev API and the local NanoJev for prompt injection, data-poisoning backdoors, membership, attribute and knowledge inference, and dual use in four detection tasks; the authors report Jev remains vulnerable to the examined threats.
papers.zh: 以官方 Jev API 和本地模型 NanoJev 检验提示注入、数据投毒后门，成员、属性与内部知识推断，以及四项检测任务中的双重用途；作者报告 Jev 对所考察的威胁仍然脆弱。

papers.title: System One Models for Wireless Decision-Making:Applications and Performance Evaluation
papers.en: Compares bounded wireless action selection with LLMs and task-specific baselines. Lower successful-request latency trades off against decision quality; a separately reported orchestration study shows that faster interpretation need not improve end-to-end completion. Local and hosted timing boundaries differ.
papers.zh: 比较有限无线动作选择、语言模型与任务专用基线。较低的成功请求耗时需与决策质量权衡；另引的编排研究表明，更快解释不一定改善端到端完成率。本地与托管计时边界也不同。

papers.title: Calibrated to Whom? Persona and Language Effects on Cultural Values in JEV
papers.en: English/Arabic persona-conditioned Jev survey audit; the effects concern simulated respondents in one model, not measurements of real populations.
papers.zh: 对 Jev 进行英语和阿拉伯语人物设定条件下的问卷审查；观察的是单一模型的模拟受访者，并非对真实人群的测量。

papers.title: Evaluating System One Models for Agent Security Decisions: Reliability, Calibration, and Selective Automation
papers.en: Examines reliability, group-specific confident errors, and selective automation in security decisions.
papers.zh: 研究安全决策中的可靠性、不同群体的高置信错误与选择性自动化。

papers.title: To Jev or Not? Evaluating the Accuracy and Efficiency of Structured Decision Models for Hate-Speech Moderation
papers.en: HATEDECIDE tests definitions and decomposed judgments across four English datasets. More explicit criteria change predictions without reliably improving annotation agreement; component outputs are not verified explanations, and diagnostic-set cost comparisons do not establish production moderation quality.
papers.zh: HATEDECIDE 在四个英语数据集上测试定义与分解判断。更明确的标准会改变预测，却不稳定提高标注一致率；组件输出不是已核验的解释，诊断集成本比较也不能证明生产审核质量。

papers.title: Batched Speech Decisions Without Decoding: Single-Token Supervision Lets a Frozen LLM Hear Beyond the Transcript
papers.en: DuplexJev connects ASR hidden states to a frozen LLM for batched answer-token readout; connector-specific speech tasks and eight-GPU timing do not establish single-device or live-agent latency.
papers.zh: DuplexJev 将 ASR 隐藏状态接入冻结 LLM，通过答案 token 读出批量决策；连接器相关的语音任务结果与八 GPU 计时，不能证明单设备或实时 agent 延迟。

papers.title: Labels Override Definitions in Jev-Style Typed Decision Models
papers.en: Studies option-label bias in open-weight decision models; prompt-rendering changes with fixed weights implicate the label/definition interface, without testing hosted Jev.
papers.zh: 研究开放权重决策模型的选项标签偏置；固定权重后改变提示渲染，指向标签／定义接口的影响，未测试托管 Jev。

papers.title: Student-Guided Teacher Distillation for Efficient LLM Task Routing: Positioning Against Jev-Style System-1 Classifiers
papers.en: Preliminary distillation for a fixed 60-label task taxonomy uses a student shortlist to reduce teacher scoring. Teacher agreement is not human accuracy; complete held-out controls remain pending, and the best checkpoint differs from the version used for serving measurements. No Jev head-to-head result is established.
papers.zh: 面向固定 60 标签任务分类的初步蒸馏研究，用学生候选表减少教师评分。与教师一致不等于人工准确率，完整留出对照仍待完成；最佳检查点与服务测量版本不同，未建立与 Jev 的直接对照结果。

papers.title: HakemBench: A Turkish Benchmark of Typed Decisions
papers.en: Turkish typed-decision evaluation reports decision quality, Brier-based probability quality and risk–coverage alongside input probes; most labels are AI-derived, and the lab’s model used feedback from earlier test results.
papers.zh: 土耳其语类型化决策评测同时报告决策质量、基于 Brier 的概率质量、风险—覆盖及输入探查；多数标签由 AI 产生，实验室自身模型还使用过先前测试结果的反馈。

papers.title: Fast Models, Slow Evidence: A Paired and Self-Audited Evaluation of System-1 Decision Models for LLM Agent Harnesses
papers.en: Paired Laya/Jev evaluation of 11 agent decision points includes a self-audit: pre-screen cost, end-to-end quality, threshold leakage and unnatural channel content change deployment conclusions. Public English-dominant labels and zero-shot configurations limit generalization.
papers.zh: 成对评测 Laya／Jev 的 11 类 agent 决策并自查流程：前置筛查成本、端到端质量、阈值泄漏及不自然的通道内容都会改变部署结论。公开、英语为主的标签和零样本配置限制泛化。

artifact_note.en: README and inventory checked; raw responses and analyses not replayed.
artifact_note.zh: 已查说明和目录，未回放原始响应或分析。

papers.title: HydroJEV: A one-second, training-free screen for cyber-attack and fault attribution in water distribution networks
papers.en: Simulated water-network triage combines Jev, rule agreement and an LLM reviewer. Fewer reviewer calls coexist with accepted attacks, event-selection constraints and a transfer endpoint that misses multiplicity correction; reported timing and non-inferiority margins do not establish field reliability.
papers.zh: 仿真水网分诊结合 Jev、规则一致与语言模型复核。减少复核调用的同时仍会接纳部分攻击，受事件选择条件限制，且一个迁移端点未通过多重比较校正；所报耗时和非劣效界不证明现场可靠性。

artifact_note.en: README and inventory checked; paper/script round numbers differ and datasets remain separate.
artifact_note.zh: 已查说明和目录；论文与脚本轮次编号不同，数据集另行取得。

papers.title: Prune First, Decide Fast: Scalable Semantic Query Processing with JEVDB
papers.en: Combines semantic SQL with relational pruning, semantic conditions and an optional decision-to-LLM cascade. Lossless pruning requires sound conditions and key extraction; empirically learned filters may lose recall. Imported SemBench baselines and separately amortized index preparation qualify efficiency comparisons.
papers.zh: 将语义 SQL、关系剪枝、语义条件与可选的决策模型—语言模型级联结合。无损剪枝依赖可靠的必要条件与键提取，经验学习的过滤器可能损失召回；引用的 SemBench 基线和单独摊销的索引准备成本限制效率比较。

artifact_note.en: Implementation README and inventory checked; package and benchmarks not executed.
artifact_note.zh: 已查实现说明和目录，未执行软件包或基准。

papers.title: AudioJev: Direct Audio Decisions with Order-Calibrated Probabilities
papers.en: Learns audio-conditioned candidate probabilities with aligned option-permutation training; order stability and empirical correctness calibration remain different properties.
papers.zh: 通过按候选身份对齐的选项重排训练学习音频条件概率；顺序稳定性与概率符合实际正确率仍是不同性质。

papers.title: Jev-IDS: System One Models for Network Intrusion Detection
papers.en: Studies typed intrusion decisions, but v1 mixes configurations: its abstract and pinned code describe a 300-flow GPT-5.6 Luna pilot, while its body describes 2,000 flows and Gemini. These cohorts and comparators must remain separate; benchmark-withheld attack types are not operational zero-day validation.
papers.zh: 研究类型化入侵判断，但 v1 混用了配置：摘要和固定代码描述 300 条流、GPT-5.6 Luna 试验，正文却描述 2,000 条流与 Gemini。两组样本及对照必须分开；基准内留出的攻击类型不等于真实零日攻击验证。

artifact_note.en: v1 abstract/body mismatch; linked code is the paper-cited pilot revision.
artifact_note.zh: v1 摘要与正文配置不一致；链接指向论文引用的试验代码版本。

papers.title: Beyond Answer Confidence: A Controlled Audit of Self-Knowledge in a Black-Box Decision Model
papers.en: Controls information and surface cues to distinguish Jev answer confidence from self-knowledge; black-box behavior does not establish access to an internal knowledge state.
papers.zh: 通过控制信息与表面线索，区分 Jev 的答案置信度与是否知道答案的自评；黑盒表现并不证明能读取内部知识状态。

papers.title: Jev-as-a-Judge for RAG Claim Verification: Confidence-Gated Cascading Between a Non-Generative Verifier and a Frontier LLM
papers.en: Paired verification of 495 RAG claims finds different false-verification rates despite similar aggregate scores. One threshold is cross-fitted, but design choices and matched random-escalation controls remain exploratory; simulated savings do not establish equivalence or a better production gate.
papers.zh: 对 495 条 RAG 声明的成对核验显示，汇总分数相近仍可有不同的误放率。一个阈值经过交叉拟合，但设计选择与同预算随机升级对照仍属探索；模拟节省不证明等效性或生产门控更优。

artifact_note.en: Gold labels require upstream dataset access; offline replay is not a deployed cascade.
artifact_note.zh: 参考标签需取得上游数据访问权限；离线回放并非已部署级联。

papers.title: AnyJev Technical Report
papers.en: Training-free decision readout with label-prior and option-order correction.
papers.zh: 无需训练的决策读出，修正标签先验与选项顺序偏差。

papers.title: JevSpawn: Adaptive Agentic Inference through Compositional Action Spaces
papers.en: Composes finite action fields and explores alternatives using interaction feedback.
papers.zh: 组合有限行动字段，利用交互反馈探索候选路径。

papers.title: OmniMed-Jev: Calibrating LVLM Confidence for Trustworthy Medical Multimodal Decisions via System One
papers.en: Medical candidate-conditioned decisions are compared with a matched generative baseline; calibration gains do not isolate interface effects from training differences or establish clinical readiness.
papers.zh: 将医学候选条件决策与匹配的生成式基线比较；校准收益未分离接口与训练差异的影响，也不能证明临床部署成熟度。

papers.title: A First Glance at Jev for Network Traffic Classification: Accuracy, Processing Time, and Cost
papers.en: Classifies ten application labels from early packet features over 26 later collection weeks. Labeled examples improve Jev but the tested tree ensembles remain more accurate; unequal supervision and service configurations prevent attributing the gap to architecture or intrinsic label efficiency.
papers.zh: 利用早期数据包特征，在后续 26 个采集周识别十类应用标签。带标签示例改善 Jev，但所测树集成仍更准确；监督预算和服务配置不同，不能把差距归因于架构或固有标签效率。

artifact_note.en: Figure/table aggregates only; not a full flow-level prediction archive.
artifact_note.zh: 仅图表汇总数据，并非完整逐流预测归档。

papers.title: When the Right Answer Is Missing: An Arithmetic-Dependent Rejection Bottleneck in Jev
papers.en: Paired numerical menus expose strong answer-present selection but weak none-of-the-above rejection. Separate development thresholds recover much of the tested rejection performance, while Boolean verification behaves differently; this diagnoses an interface-dependent failure, not hidden model mechanisms or universal threshold transfer.
papers.zh: 成对数值候选集揭示：答案存在时选择较强，缺失时却难以选中“以上皆非”。独立开发集阈值改善了所测拒答表现，布尔核验则呈现不同结果；这是接口相关失效诊断，不揭示内部机制或普遍阈值迁移。

papers.title: Bongard: Training Machine Intuition
papers.en: Shared evidence encoding and candidate-probability readout, trained with representation and action-outcome feedback.
papers.zh: 共享证据编码与候选概率读出，结合表征学习和行动结果反馈训练。

papers.title: OpenJev-RLCD: A Working RLCD Implementation
papers.en: An independent two-stage RLCD recipe calibrates a reasoning model's answer readout, then reinforces rationales with a proper-score reward. Three-seed results on a 1.7B model show task-dependent gains; the implementation explicitly makes no claim to recover TypeSafe's internal training algorithm.
papers.zh: 独立的两阶段 RLCD 方法先校准推理模型的答案读出，再用适当评分奖励强化推理。1.7B 模型上的三种子结果显示收益随任务变化；实现明确不声称还原 TypeSafe 内部训练算法。

artifact_note.en: Independent implementation; released result files were not replayed.
artifact_note.zh: 独立实现，未回放公开结果文件。

papers.title: Evaluating and Benchmarking the System One Model Jev
papers.en: An early benchmark study of Jev. Read the task selection and evaluation setup alongside its reported results.
papers.zh: Jev 的早期基准研究。阅读报告结果时，同时检查任务选择与评测设置。

papers.title: Chinese-Jev: Bringing System One Model to Chinese-Language Tasks
papers.en: A Chinese typed-decision model and proposed benchmark; domain-specific training calls for independent validation.
papers.zh: 面向中文的类型化决策模型与新基准；领域专用训练的效果仍需独立验证。

papers.title: Dyad: Extending Large Language Models with Native Typed Decision-Making
papers.en: Adds an environment-conditioned action encoder to an LLM for typed actions; frozen-LLM adaptation and joint reinforcement learning are separate settings, and the Jev latency comparison uses previously published API measurements.
papers.zh: 为 LLM 加入环境条件化行动编码器以选择类型化动作；冻结 LLM 仅适配编码器与联合强化学习是不同设置，Jev 延迟比较引用既有 API 测量。

papers.title: Mnemon: Raw Records, Fast Judgments, Slow Thoughts
papers.en: Keeps raw memory records, separating Jev relevance judgments from LLM search planning and answer generation.
papers.zh: 保留原始记忆记录，将 Jev 相关性判断与 LLM 检索规划、回答生成分开。

papers.title: Jev thinks “I don't know”, but doesn't say it: Introducing Sys1Cal-v1 Dataset for Probability Calibration
papers.en: A controlled calibration study using constructed probabilities. Interpretations of latent uncertainty remain hypotheses.
papers.zh: 使用构造概率进行受控校准测试；对潜在不确定性的解释仍属研究假说。

papers.title: Decide, Don't Generate: Competitive Dimensional ABSA with Jev's Typed Decisions
papers.en: Uses frozen Jev decisions plus 488 coefficients fitted to labels for multilingual sentiment regression and extraction. Supervised calibration and span selection drive the gains; reconstructed aggregate rankings, reused development data and incomplete overlap removal qualify the comparisons.
papers.zh: 将冻结的 Jev 决策与 488 个由标签拟合的系数结合，用于多语言情感回归和抽取。监督校准与片段选择贡献主要收益；重建的汇总排名、重复使用的开发数据及未完全排除的重叠，限制比较结论。

artifact_note.en: Code, fitted parameters and summaries; dataset text and prediction caches are not distributed.
artifact_note.zh: 代码、拟合参数与汇总结果；未分发数据文本及预测缓存。

papers.title: JEV as a Judge for Agent Trace Security: An Empirical Comparison with Generative LLM Judges
papers.en: Compares Jev and generative judges on retrospective agent-trace risk classification; dataset rankings vary, and successful-call latency and valid-judgment cost must be read with coverage.
papers.zh: 比较 Jev 与生成式评判模型对历史 agent 轨迹的风险分类；排名因数据集而异，成功调用耗时和有效判断成本需结合覆盖率解读。

papers.title: Emo-Jev: Probabilistic Reasoning for Emotion Classification with Jev
papers.en: Adds atomic-question decomposition or multiple judgment paths for eight text-classification benchmarks. Neither extension improves average macro-F1 over direct Jev in the reported setup; extra questions increase cost, and fixed aggregation rules do not establish calibrated uncertainty.
papers.zh: 在八个文本分类基准上加入原子问题分解或多条判断路径；所报设置中，两种扩展的平均宏 F1 均未超过直接 Jev。额外问题增加成本，固定聚合规则也不能证明不确定性已校准。

papers.title: Laya as a Typed Probabilistic Assessor: An Independent Reproduction and a Preregistered Study of Calibration and Selective Escalation
papers.en: A pinned Laya checkpoint is underconfident on synthetic teacher labels. Temperature fitting improves probability metrics, but the frozen calibrator-selection rule and escalation gate fail held-out targets; reported Jev comparisons are indirect, and the initial reproduction predates preregistration.
papers.zh: 固定版本 Laya 检查点在合成教师标签上信心不足。温度拟合改善概率指标，但冻结的校准器选择规则与升级门控未达到留出目标；Jev 对照来自间接引用，初始复现早于预注册。

artifact_note.en: Metric code and ancillary records; full training/collection source is not included.
artifact_note.zh: 指标代码与附属记录；不包含完整训练／采集源码。

papers.title: Type-Safe Decision Frameworks for Agentic 5G Control: A Theory-Driven Testbed Characterization of Where They Can Be Applied
papers.en: Maps typed frameworks to timing, label-budget and decision-schema conditions on a 5G testbed. Changed-question probes expose failures hidden by output validity and paraphrase stability; simulator labels, open RAN-loop scope and conditional risk assumptions constrain deployment conclusions.
papers.zh: 在 5G 测试床上按时限、标签预算和决策模式评估类型化框架。改变问题的探针揭示了输出合法性与改写稳定性掩盖的失效；仿真标签、未闭合的 RAN 回路及有条件风险假设限制部署结论。

papers.title: Beyond Calibration: Do a Typed-Decision Model's Probabilities Obey the Probability Axioms?
papers.en: Tests coherence between logically related probabilities, separately from accuracy and calibration.
papers.zh: 检验逻辑相关命题的概率一致性，与准确率和校准分别考察。

papers.title: PACT: Pairwise-Anchored Calibrated Tuning for Single-Token Typed Decisions
papers.en: Uses certified contrastive pairs, permutation consistency and contextual temperature fitting to improve decision stability and ordinal error; a 324-item synthetic holdout, one model scale and certificate dependence limit generalization.
papers.zh: 利用带证书的对比样本对、排列一致性和上下文温度拟合改善决策稳定性与序数误差；留出集仅324条合成样本，模型尺度单一，且依赖证书正确性，推广范围有限。

artifact_note.en: Paper results are separate from the repository’s later single-run Tetris demo.
artifact_note.zh: 论文结果与仓库中后续的单次 Tetris 演示应分开解读。

papers.title: Typed Decision Models: An Early Evidence Audit and Evaluation Checklist
papers.en: An evidence audit and a checklist for evaluating typed decision models.
papers.zh: 围绕类型化决策模型的证据审查与评估清单。

papers.title: JevAdvBench: A Benchmark and Black-Box Attacks for Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions Models
papers.en: A black-box adversarial benchmark. A changed decision is not necessarily an incorrect decision.
papers.zh: 黑盒对抗评测基准。决策发生变化，并不必然代表决策错误。

papers.title: LAVOIR: Teaching a Single-Pass Decision Encoder When and What to Ask with Amortized Value of Information
papers.en: Estimates whether asking for missing information would improve a typed decision.
papers.zh: 估计追问缺失信息是否有助于改进类型化决策。

papers.title: Jev-Mobile: Jev as an Executor for Mobile GUI Agents
papers.en: Uses VLM local-goal planning with Jev action selection over Android accessibility-tree candidates; reported time and API-cost savings are conditional on successful trajectories and the tested controller configurations.
papers.zh: 用 VLM 规划局部目标，再由 Jev 从 Android 无障碍树候选中选动作；报告的时延和 API 成本节省仅针对成功轨迹及所测控制器配置。

papers.title: Just Ask Jev: Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions as a Zero-Shot Detector of AI Alignment Failures
papers.en: Benchmarks Jev alignment-failure detection while separating question wording from input context; benchmark-scorer labels dominate, and context gains often depend on fields encoding the label.
papers.zh: 评测 Jev 对 AI 对齐失效的检测，分别改变提问与输入上下文；参考标签主要来自基准评分器，上下文收益常依赖编码标签的字段。

papers.title: From Text Decisions to Pixels: An Study of Jev-Style Visual Choice Model
papers.en: A Jev-style visual-choice study separating adaptation gains, candidate-readout validity, and calibration limits.
papers.zh: Jev 风格视觉选择模型研究，区分适配收益、候选读出有效性与校准局限。

papers.title: Decision Hijacking: Prompt Injection Attacks on Jev's Typed Probabilistic Decisions
papers.en: Audits Jev injection on reconstructed InjecAgent cases, separating probability shifts from attacker-target selections; optimization results are checked on fresh calls, within this benchmark setting.
papers.zh: 在重构的 InjecAgent 案例中审查 Jev 提示注入，区分概率偏移与攻击目标选择；优化结果通过新调用验证，结论限于该基准设置。

papers.title: NumericJev: Jev-like LLM Numerical Decoding with Multiway Decision Trees
papers.en: Uses repeated Choice calls to refine a known numerical interval without retraining. Resolution is not accuracy or calibrated uncertainty, and early wrong branches are irreversible. Arithmetic variants share 64 base families; historical-index recall and later controller demonstrations are separate evidence.
papers.zh: 无需重训，通过重复 Choice 调用缩小已知数值区间。分辨率不等于准确性或已校准不确定性，早期错误分支不可逆。算术变体共享 64 个基础问题族；历史指数回忆与后续控制演示属于不同证据。

artifact_note.en: Renamed JevNext repository; current release declares PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0.
artifact_note.zh: 仓库已更名 JevNext，当前版本声明 PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0。

papers.title: Can Jev Judge Radiology Reports? Evaluating a System One Model for Clinical Factuality
papers.en: Jev checks support between generated and reference radiology reports in both directions; expert agreement depends on report size and error definitions and does not establish prospective clinical effectiveness.
papers.zh: Jev 双向检查生成与参考放射学报告之间的陈述支持关系；与专家的一致性受报告长度和错误定义影响，并不证明前瞻性临床效果。

papers.title: KITE: Scaling Jev Population Experiments with Sparse Flagship Calibration
papers.en: Jev state tables and sparse flagship-model anchors support population simulations with shared human–model discrepancy estimates; larger simulations do not add human evidence or establish prospective intervention effects.
papers.zh: Jev 状态表与少量强模型锚点支持纳入共享人—模型差异估计的群体模拟；扩大模拟规模不会增加人类证据，也不能确立前瞻性干预效果。

papers.title: JEV-Star: Fast, Low-Cost StarCraft II Control with Language-Model Planning
papers.en: Combines Jev action selection with persistent language-model planning for StarCraft II; limited full-game evidence and simultaneous interface changes prevent isolating the planning contribution.
papers.zh: 在星际争霸 II 中结合 Jev 动作选择与持续的语言模型规划；完整对局证据有限，同时发生的接口变化使规划贡献无法单独归因。

papers.title: Evaluating Decision Models for Text Annotation in Computational Social Science
papers.en: Evaluates zero-shot social-science annotation and confidence-routed LLM cascades; lower costs coexist with task-dependent errors and overconfidence, so confidence cannot substitute for label validation.
papers.zh: 评估零样本社会科学标注与按置信度分流的 LLM 级联；低成本仍伴随任务相关误差和过度自信，置信度不能替代标签验证。

papers.title: REFLEX with Jev for Efficient Selective Control in LLM Agents
papers.en: Confidence-gated Jev control with LLM fallback; gains depend on action alternatives and baseline routing.
papers.zh: 以置信度控制 Jev 与 LLM 回退；收益取决于候选动作与基线路由。

papers.title: Visual Jev: Accurate and Efficient Decisions from Shared Visual Context
papers.en: An independent visual decision architecture shares image context across batched questions using an LM-head readout; warm amortized speedups trade higher peak memory, while accuracy gains concentrate on trained task families.
papers.zh: 独立的视觉决策架构以语言模型头读出，让批处理问题共享图像上下文；预热后的摊销加速伴随更高峰值内存，准确率收益集中于训练覆盖的任务家族。

papers.title: Jev-Mem: System-One-Controlled Agentic Memory for Efficient AI Agents
papers.en: Studies Jev as a controller for agent memory. Reported outcomes concern the complete memory workflow.
papers.zh: 研究以 Jev 控制 agent 记忆；报告结果衡量完整记忆工作流。

papers.title: this-that-model-1.0: A typed decision model that decides in 30 ms, for a millionth of a cent
papers.en: An open typed-decision model using hidden-state readout. The abstract reports a small external comparison.
papers.zh: 采用隐藏状态读出的开放类型化决策模型。摘要报告了一项小规模外部比较。
